wireParity.seedCases: zero weights and +/-1e-7 weights exercising shrink-to-zero

mathematics.objective: Exact permutation joint NLL + 0.0005 * sum(group L2 norms), before and after parameters at the identical pre-label raw lag context
mathematics.gradientNorm: Composite objective subgradient; select the valid zero regularizer subgradient at a zero group
mathematics.optimizer: Original smooth NLL step 0.02 followed by exact group proximal shrinkage with threshold 0.02 * 0.0005; all numeric operations retain their old ordering
mathematics.independentGradientOracle: Invert the actual nonzero proximal result to recover the smooth gradient, then add the regularizer subgradient; compare 64 numerical directional derivatives

counterProvenance.fresh: Complete known training updates; observeOnly never increments this counter; gaps retain it
counterProvenance.oldV1V2: Unknown prior training history. Start counting actual updates since import from zero; old context clock can include observation-only events and is not inferred to be a lower bound for training updates.
counterProvenance.v3: Original v2 numeric prefix plus int64 update counter and provenance byte; previous numeric projection preserved
